2609.23989.title: ACLArena: Agent Continue Learning in Multi-stage Post-training
2609.23989.paper_summary: Building general-purpose agents for industrial deployment requires integrating multiple capabilities, each typically acquired at a distinct stage of training. Yet there is currently no well-established recipe for Agent Continual Learning (ACL), with little understanding of the trade-offs among existing integration paradigms. To address this gap, we introduce ACLArena, a framework for comprehensively studying, analyzing, and evaluating ACL. We first build a sequential training pipeline and conduct an in-depth analysis that explains the mechanisms of forgetting and generalization from two complementary perspectives, the model level and the token level. Guided by these analyses, we systematically compare multi-teacher on-policy distillation, self-distilled fine-tuning, and model merging to assess their ability to recover previously learned capabilities while preserving newly acquired ones. Through extensive experiments, we develop a detailed understanding of how capabilities transfer across stages. Finally, we propose a new ACL recipe that combines offline replay over high-quality trajectories with a routed network of multiple LoRA experts each specialized via RL, substantially improving the agent's ability to learn across multiple domains. Comprehensive experiments on four reasoning and agentic tasks, evaluated under both in-domain and out-of-domain settings, demonstrate the value of our analysis and the effectiveness of our approach.
2609.23989.paper_summary_zh: 建立用於工業部署的通用代理需要整合多種能力，而這些能力通常是在訓練的不同階段獲得的。<lb/>然而，目前尚無成熟的代理持續學習（ACL）方案，對於現有整合範式之間的權衡也缺乏了解。<lb/>為了解決這一空白，我們引入了ACLArena，一個用於全面研究、分析和評估ACL的框架。<lb/>我們首先建立了一個順序訓練管道，並進行深入分析，從模型層面和標記層面兩個互補的角度解釋遺忘和泛化的機制。<lb/>在這些分析的指導下，我們系統地比較了多教師在政策蒸餾、自我蒸餾微調和模型合併，以評估它們在保持新獲得能力的同時恢復先前學習能力的能力。<lb/>通過大量實驗，我們詳細了解了能力如何在不同階段之間轉移。<lb/>最後，我們提出了一種新的ACL方案，結合了對高質量軌跡的離線重播和通過強化學習專門化的多個LoRA專家的路由網絡，顯著提高了代理在多個領域學習的能力。<lb/>在四個推理和代理任務上進行的全面實驗，在域內和域外設置下進行評估，展示了我們分析的價值和我們方法的有效性。
